stock.description: Playmates Toys Limited operates as an investment holding company, focusing on the conceptualization, manufacturing, promotion, and distribution of a diverse range of toys and family entertainment products. Their offerings are available under well-known brand names such as Godzilla vs. Kong, Miraculous, Spy Ninjas, Vlad & Niki, Pikwik Pack, Billie Eilish, Disney, Classic Godzilla Titans, Miraculous Ladybug, and TMNT vs Cobra Kai. The company maintains a global presence, conducting business in Hong Kong, the United States, Europe, the Asia Pacific, and other international markets. Established in 1966, its headquarters are situated in Tsimshatsui, Hong Kong. Playmates Toys Limited is a part of PIL Toys Limited.
